react_result.final_narrative_text: Four independent enrichment paradigms converged on a single dominant biological signal: altered arachidonic acid metabolism in the treatment group. RaMP multi-DB ORA returned Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) as the top-ranked pathway with an FDR of 3.11e-15 and a fold enrichment of 2001.5, driven by five of the eight input metabolites (arachidonic acid, 5-HETE, 15-deoxy-PGJ2, 15-HETE, and leukotriene A4). The MetaboAnalystR KEGG-specific PSEA independently identified KEGG:hsa00590 (Arachidonic acid metabolism) as its sole significant hit (p=2.49e-06), overlapping the same four compounds (arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 15-HETE, 5-HETE). The Mummichog m/z-direct network analysis placed Arachidonic acid metabolism at rank 1 (p=0.000252) with 14 overlapping metabolites, and Leukotriene metabolism appeared at rank 3 (p=0.019), capturing both arachidonic acid and leukotriene A4. The two phenolic acids (3,4-dihydroxybenzeneacetic acid and 4-hydroxybenzoic acid) did not contribute to any arachidonic acid pathway hit; their signal appears biologically secondary. The cross-paradigm winner is unambiguously arachidonic acid metabolism, with five driver metabolites spanning the COX, LOX, and EET branches of the eicosanoid network.
